zoe_cs: Quick heads-up 1: LumenHealth raised an onboarding question on todays call: initial-request latency spikes during warmup. They want to know if those minutes count against their SLO and whether credits are on the table.

mike_reliability: Short answer: warmup/cold-cache spikes are real. Our standard SLO measurement is 1-minute windows of request latency (p95/p99 depending on contract). We generally dont auto-exclude warmup unless contract says so.

nina_eng: Tech detail: cause is KV cache population + occasional shard cold-starts. For many short sessions the first turn can be 27x slower for 1-3 requests until the prefix cache is filled. Mitigations: sticky sessions, prefix prefetch, or a preheat job.

sam_account_mgr: LumenHealth flagged this as a renewal sensitivity. They want a customer-ready explanation + remediation options before exec readout next Tue. Also asked if a temporary credit would be easier than changing config.

mike_reliability: Proposed outline for the note: 1) short lay explanation, 2) exact SLO math we use, 3) cause + evidence query, 4) 3 remediation choices with ETA & cost, 5) credit policy suggestion with a worked example, 6) next steps and owners.

zoe_cs: Ill draft the customer text. Nina please add one-line benefit and ETA for each mitigation so we can show impact.

nina_eng: Quick bullets: - sticky sessions (tenant cookie/affinity): 35-55% improvement first-turn; low risk; ETA 4 business days. - prefix prefetch: 60-80% improvement but needs testing; ETA 10 business days. - deploy preheat job: up to 90% elimination of warmup cases; quick to run but adds compute; ETA 2 days. Snippet for preheat API: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompts":["init"],"concurrency":3}'
```

sam_account_mgr: Add cost roughs so they can compare credits vs preheat trial. Suggest offering a free 2-week preheat trial during onboarding.

mike_reliability: For credits: recommend conservative policy to move quickly: only consider credits if we confirm breach pattern correlating to first-request spikes AND customer cannot adopt mitigation within N days. Cap credits to 2% of monthly bill and require logs as evidence. Keep formula simple for legal.

zoe_cs: Example credit calc to include in note (customer-facing): 
- Contract SLO: 95th latency <= 150ms (measured per-minute)
- Observed minute avg: 300ms -> excess 150ms = 100% over SLO -> count as affected minute
- Credit for affected minutes = (affected minutes / total billing minutes) * monthly bill * 2% cap

mike_reliability: Ok. Also add an operational guardrail: if warmup pattern persists after we enable sticky sessions, escalate to infra for deeper tracing.

nina_eng: Ill post the exact query to detect warmup spikes (session-first-request correlation + cache_miss flag) in this thread in 1hr.

zoe_cs: Action list: Zoe (draft + send to LumenHealth), Nina (metrics query + ETA + snippet), Mike (confirm legal phrasing & credit cap), Sam (customer context + exec prep). Offer: 2-week free preheat trial to show improvements.

uptime-bot: Note: no active SLA incident. Recent deploy (2026-06-03T08:14Z) included kernel update to reduce tail variance.

zoe_cs: Draft will be posted here by EOD. If anyone objects to the 2% cap or the trial, flag now.

mike_reliability: No objections from SRE.

nina_eng: No objections, will drop query soon.

sam_account_mgr: Ready to brief renewal team once note is finalized.

zoe_cs: Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/lumen-warmup-note (internal). Review requested by 1700. :rocket:
